runtime: python3 (>=3.8, stdlib only) — no pip installs, no network

entrypoints.sbom: scripts/bomscan.py sbom DIR [-o OUT.json] [--name N --version V]

exit_codes.0: ok / policy pass (or WARN — no findings at/above fail-severity)
exit_codes.2: usage error (bad flags; ruleset registry self-check trip)
exit_codes.4: policy FAIL: verdict FAIL at --fail-severity, or audit chain broken

rules: SEC-01 committed-secret patterns (ZERO-character redaction: [REDACTED len=N sha256:TAG])
DEP-01 unpinned dependencies: npm exact-x.y.z only; pip without ==; pyproject (PEP-621 arrays + Poetry tables) via the SBOM parser

NET-01 egress drift: http[s]/ftp[s]/sftp/ssh/git/ws/wss URLs + IP literals vs SKILL.md metadata.network.outbound; boundary-safe host match (u==h or u.endswith('.'+h)); 'outbound:[*]' collapses to none-declared
GO-01 go.mod replace/retract directives (local-path fork risk, LOW)
ruleset.anti_hallucination: engine hard-fails (rc2) if any emitted control ref is absent from the static CONTROL_REGISTRY; selftest asserts every finding ref resolves

policy.secret_redaction: zero characters of a matched value leave the engine; findings carry kind/length/sha256-tag only
policy.audit: hash-chained JSONL (O_NOFOLLOW, fchmod 0600 at create, seq per record), ${AGENT_BOM_AUDIT:-DIR/.agent_bom_audit.jsonl}; keyless-chain limits documented
policy.sbom_spec: CycloneDX 1.5 JSON (ECMA-424); bom-refs deduped/unique; satisfies NTIA/CISA minimum SBOM elements for the manifest ecosystems parsed

honest_scope: verifiable-compliance SIGNAL generator. Not a SOC2/ISO27001/CMMC certification engine; those require accredited auditors. Cited OWASP LLM refs are the 2025 edition (stable numbering).
